tucker-carlson-2026-fara-referral.body:
The **Tucker Carlson 2026 FARA referral** is the criminal referral to the U.S. Department of Justice against [Tucker Carlson](/wiki/tucker-carlson) that alleged treason, espionage and Foreign Agents Registration Act violations and that circulated in March 2026 as an [AIPAC](/wiki/aipac)-adjacent escalation of the campaign against him.<Cite t="47:21" /><Cite t="47:52" />

## Kiriakou's misattribution and the Loomer claim

[John Kiriakou](/wiki/john-kiriakou) — a personal friend of Carlson's — said the reflexive assumption when the news broke was that the [CIA](/wiki/cia) had filed the report, because *"they file crimes reports against people every single day."* Kiriakou said the attribution *"didn't really make sense to me"* even as it circulated, and Carlson himself initially took the same view. The next day, on Kiriakou's account, the pro-Israel political activist Laura Loomer publicly claimed authorship of the referral, in what Kiriakou characterises as an admission of being *"an instrument of Israel."*<Cite t="47:21" /><Cite t="47:52" />

## Legal versus physical exposure

Carlson had told Kiriakou he saw no serious legal jeopardy — he was, in his own words to Kiriakou, *"blessed with plenty of money"* and had *"great lawyers"* — and that the referral was *"meant to silence me — and it's not going to silence me."* Kiriakou agrees on the legal analysis but says he worries about Carlson's physical safety: *"there are a lot of crazy people out there,"* and *"lie in wait for somebody like … happened to [Charlie Kirk](/wiki/charlie-kirk-shooting)"* is a pattern he takes seriously. Carlson no longer lives in Washington, D.C., which Kiriakou treats as an incidental protection.<Cite t="48:24" /><Cite t="48:56" /><Cite t="49:27" />

## What Kiriakou reads the referral as being for

Kiriakou treats the referral as an example of a broader pattern: *"this case is not about"* Carlson specifically, in the same way his own [Espionage Act](/wiki/espionage-act) prosecution was *"not about John Kiriakou"* — it is about *"silencing literally anybody who may be thinking of blowing the whistle on waste, fraud, abuse, or threats to the public health or public safety."*<Cite t="49:27" />
